name: page-gate-v0
initialization_basis: run.py (sha256 3d4c39913d5439914488aead0ed8ef633f8d31a4ae0e46e264c5b1780abb8700) seeds the generator, builds ContextPageSegmenter(config) and trains it; its only load_state_dict reloads its own best.pt after training.

training.loss: per-image BCE+soft Dice, smooth=1; train weights N/(3*N_domain); batch mean
training.selection: maximum validation three-domain macro raw mask IoU, earliest tie

data.source: Project-authored text, unchanged bundled font, analytic warps and procedural backgrounds
synthetic/paper.py cylinder and perspective augmentation of SmartDoc 2015 Challenge 1 templates
SmartDoc 2015 Challenge 1 frames with four-corner planar masks

attribution: Jean-Christophe Burie, Joseph Chazalon, Mickael Coustaty, Sebastien Eskenazi, Muhammad Muzzamil Luqman, Maroua Mehri, Nibal Nayef, Jean-Marc Ogier, Sophea Prum and Marcal Rusinol: ICDAR2015 Competition on Smartphone Document Capture and OCR (SmartDoc). ICDAR 2015.
license_notes: SmartDoc 2015 Challenge 1 is CC BY 4.0; its readme says original images remain the property of their respective authors.

recorded_validation.measurement: mask IoU, 384x288, threshold 0.5, mean over images

limitations: one seed; repeatedly used development validation
localizer metrics do not establish dewarping or SOTA quality
trained on printed pages only; no-page negatives were never evaluated
